error.message: E-SCOPE-KEY-REMOVED: kb_query no longer accepts 'repo_path' (removed in the KB redesign); the call was not run and no KB was changed. Remediation: repo_path: nothing -- drop it: every kb_* call acts on the calling session's own KB (a member session's registered work folder; a FULL session's fleet server working folder). To act on another repository, call from a member session registered on that folder.
